author: Kai Moreno
title: Webhook signing secret rotation
content:
# Purpose
Customers who subscribe to usage or invoice webhooks rotate the signing secret that verifies our POST bodies. This is not an API key in Console.

# When to use
They mention webhook, HMAC, signing secret, or invoice.callback. They do not mention a Console key name.

# Steps
In Console go to Settings → Webhooks → Rotate secret. Deploy the new secret to their receiver. Old secret verifies for 24 hours. After that, requests with the old secret fail signature checks.

# Priority and routing
How-to rotations are P4, Support, no security-incident label. A leaked webhook secret is still not an API key disable: tell them to rotate the webhook secret and watch their receiver logs.

# Guardrails
Do not call POST /api_keys/*/disable for a webhook secret. Webhook secrets are not in the API-keys table.

# Related
Webhook payload reference. Invoice webhook guide.
